generation.text:
A common weather pattern is the formation of a thunderstorm. 

On a hot summer day, the sun heats up the ground and warm air rises. As the warm air rises, it creates an area of low pressure near the surface. Cooler, denser air from surrounding areas then flows in to fill the low pressure area. This cooler air is forced to rise over the warm air, creating wind and turbulence.

As the cooler air rises, it cools and condenses into water
